items.text: Thirty is not a deadline, but it is a genuine inflection point: usually five to nine years into a career, with real skill and track record already built, and still early enough that a deliberate change of direction is realistic rather than a leap.

This guidance is built around using that window deliberately - toward a high-value skill portfolio and stronger income trajectory, before dependents, a home loan, or another decade of momentum make the same decision harder to make.
